set(GSXI_MINIZ_VERSION "3.1.2")
set(GSXI_MINIZ_SOURCE_SHA256 "e2c1aeb66eef9191d8c3feb164db2def2335a61d039bf04ed849f6b042433b30")
set(GSXI_MINIZ_HEADER_SHA256 "b53b62ed122e559b8f679e3cb787a0b0035fe87a58f909da0e44931678f4e85f")

file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/miniz.c" GSXI_MINIZ_SOURCE_ACTUAL)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/miniz.h" GSXI_MINIZ_HEADER_ACTUAL)
if (NOT GSXI_MINIZ_SOURCE_ACTUAL STREQUAL GSXI_MINIZ_SOURCE_SHA256
        OR NOT GSXI_MINIZ_HEADER_ACTUAL STREQUAL GSXI_MINIZ_HEADER_SHA256)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "third_party/miniz does not match the pinned miniz ${GSXI_MINIZ_VERSION} amalgamation.")
endif ()

add_library(miniz STATIC miniz.c miniz.h)
target_include_directories(miniz SYSTEM PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
target_compile_definitions(miniz PUBLIC MINIZ_NO_STDIO MINIZ_NO_TIME)
set_target_properties(miniz PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
